name: PQC Experiment
description: Hands-on post-quantum measurement: benchmarks, key and signature size comparisons, known-answer tests, and runnable experiments on constrained hardware.
author: your-name

routing.description_for_router: Benchmark ML-KEM-768 key generation and report the timings. Measure how long ML-DSA-65 takes to sign a thousand messages. Write a script that generates a keypair and times it. Time encapsulation and decapsulation on my phone. Check my implementation against the known-answer test vectors. How many signatures per second can this hardware manage? How much memory does SLH-DSA signing use at runtime? Profile where the time goes and show me the median and the p95. Run it a thousand iterations and tell me if it got slower.
